title: Gundam Versus workspace
credit: Format research: kjjkjjzyayufqza, built on this project's VS2 / Over Boost findings.

credits.researchNote: GVS support is kjjkjjzyayufqza's own result, derived from EXVS Mod Project's VS2 / Over Boost research.

add.title: Add file
add.description: The file is copied into the package, listed in the chosen folder and placed in its type group.
add.typeHint: Type ids group files inside the archive; the extension decides it unless you pick one.

folder.title: Add folder
folder.description: Create an empty folder node in the archive structure.
folder.name: Name
folder.nameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
folder.addHint: Use Add file or Add folder in the package pane; new nodes go into the selected folder.

replace.title: Replace file
replace.description: Replace the data of {{path}} with another file.
replace.shared: This file is listed {{count}} times in the structure; every listing will use the new data.

inspector.removeBody: Remove {{path}} from the structure? The file is deleted from the package.
inspector.removeListingBody: Remove this listing of {{path}}? The file stays because it is listed {{count}} times.
inspector.removeFolderBody: Remove folder {{name}} and its {{count}} children? Files that no other node lists are deleted.

texture.importTitle: Choose a PNG or DDS image
texture.name: Name
texture.importHint: DDS files are stored as-is; PNG files are encoded with generated mipmaps. The sRGB flag and nutexb version are kept.
texture.notDecodable: This texture cannot be previewed (swizzle {{swizzle}}), but DDS export and import still work.

single.title: Single FHM2D
single.intro: Unpack one GVS archive into a named package folder, or repack a package folder into the mod folder.
